import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title_tag = book.find("div", class_="book-title")
        author_tag = book.find("div", class_="book-author")
        year_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-year")
        rating_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-rating")
        price_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-price")

        title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True) if title_tag else ""
        author = ""
        if author_tag:
            author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_tag.get_text(strip=True))
        year = int(re.search(r"\d{4}", year_tag.get_text())) if year_tag and re.search(r"\d{4}", year_tag.get_text()) else None
        rating = float(re.search(r"[\d.]+\s*/\s*5", rating_tag.get_text()).group().split("/")[0].strip()) if rating_tag and re.search(r"[\d.]+\s*/\s*5", rating_tag.get_text()) else None
        price = float(re.sub(r"[^\d.]", "", price_tag.get_text())) if price_tag else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("/app/books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    lines = []
    lines.append("Book Store Scraping Summary Report")
    lines.append("=" * 40)
    lines.append(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}")
    lines.append(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} by {highest['author']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5)")

    with open("/app/report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    print("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF

  "analysis": "The server responds and the HTML exactly matches the documented template. Each book is in <div class="book"> with book-title, book-author (prefixed 'by '), and spans book-year ('Published: YEAR'), book-rating ('Rating: X/5'), book-price ('$PRICE'). I'll write the scraper now.",
  "plan": "Create scraper.py using a heredoc. It will fetch the page, parse books, build a DataFrame, save books.csv, and write report.txt with total count, average price, and the highest-rated book. Then run it and verify the outputs.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/scraper.py << 'EOF'
import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title_tag = book.find("div", class_="book-title")
        author_tag = book.find("div", class_="book-author")
        year_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-year")
        rating_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-rating")
        price_tag = book.find("span", class_="book-price")

        title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True) if title_tag else ""
        author = ""
        if author_tag:
            author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_tag.get_text(strip=True))
        year = int(re.search(r"\d{4}", year_tag.get_text())) if year_tag and re.search(r"\d{4}", year_tag.get_text()) else None
        rating = float(re.search(r"[\d.]+\s*/\s*5", rating_tag.get_text()).group().split("/")[0].strip()) if rating_tag and re.search(r"[\d.]+\s*/\s*5", rating_tag.get_text()) else None
        price = float(re.sub(r"[^\d.]", "", price_tag.get_text())) if price_tag else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("/app/books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    lines = []
    lines.append("Book Store Scraping Summary Report")
    lines.append("=" * 40)
    lines.append(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}")
    lines.append(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} by {highest['author']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5)")

    with open("/app/report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    print("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
